Q5786.reason: Post-accident refusal of care is a failure to mitigate, so the estate recovers only for the wound and suffering up to the refusal; it is not contributory negligence and does not bar the original injury.

Q5086.reason: Anaerobic metabolism means ATP-generating pathways that do not use oxygen, and those pathways still run when oxygen is available.

Q5171.reason: After a unit leaves refrigeration the transfusion should be started within 30 minutes; four hours is the deadline to finish it, not to begin.
